status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 150% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 150 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: US officials are weighing a military training and demining mission for Syrian forces, while a budget shortfall threatens the chemical weapons watchdog’s ability to continue work in Syria. Israeli forces raided southern Syria, wounding Syrian soldiers, and a drone strike in western Sweida injured four Syrian internal security personnel. In Damascus countryside, two Christian young men were found dead, and in Homs a church robbery led to the arrest of suspects, including a guard. A son of a Daesh leader was killed in Homs. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: US-offiserer vurderer et militært trenings- og mineryddingsoppdrag for syriske styrker, mens et budsjettunderskudd truer kjemivåpenkontrollens evne til å fortsette arbeidet i Syria. Israelske styrker gjennomførte et raid i sørlige Syria, og såret syriske soldater, og et droneangrep i vestlige Sweida påførte fire syriske interne sikkerhetspersonell skader. På landsbygda utenfor Damaskus ble to unge kristne menn funnet døde, og i Homs førte et kirketyveri til pågripelse av mistenkte, inkludert en vakt. En sønn av en Daesh-leder ble drept i Homs. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
